Overview

Hialeah is a city in FL with a population of 222,797. Cuban-American heart of Miami with Spanish-speaking culture, no state income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 45.9.
